'''Verls Tarrk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] tasked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operative with [[Death/Legends|killing]] her while she was in her [[Rebel bunker (Dantooine)|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="SWG:IM" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Verls Tarrk was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Verls Tarrk was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:IM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
